text: Vishal and Swati rent a high-rise apartment at a suspiciously low price, and Vishal hides that the last tenant, a widow named Manjeet, [is said to have killed her son and herself|trigger|a secret surfaces]. Swati begins seeing things, then shouting in Manjeet's manner, and the watchman is found with his neck snapped backwards. As an inspector circles and an exorcist reads the spirits, the couple learn that Manjeet [returns to take Swati's body|threat|being taken over] to [expose the man who pushed her from the balcony|wants|revenge for a wrong].
